Name: StardewThief
Author: lilili54621852
Description:
[center][b][size=6]StardewThief[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4]The Ultimate Extraction Experience in Pelican Town
[/size][/b]
[line]
[/center]
[center][i][color=#efefef]Tired of honest farming? It’s time to diversify your income streams.[/color][/i][/center]
[b]StardewThief[/b] brings a thrilling [b]extraction-style (Loot & Extract)[/b] gameplay loop to Stardew Valley. Infiltrate buildings, loot everything you can carry, and get out before anyone notices. One bad move and you leave empty-handed. Plan well, and Pelican Town is your personal treasure chest.
[line]
[center][size=5][b]🌟 Key Features[/b] [/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b]The "Loot & Extract" Burglary System[/b] [/size][/center]
Every heist is a tense puzzle where you must manage your alert level and avoid NPC line-of-sight. Grab the valuables and make your escape before the whole town wakes up. If you get caught, you lose your stolen goods and face a hefty fine. 
[center][b][size=5]Daylight Robbery:[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b]Mask On, Morals Off[/b] [/center]
Don't want to wait until nightfall? Put on a mask and rob the place in broad daylight. The risks are higher, but the adrenaline rush is unmatched. Just make sure you have an escape route planned. 

[center][b][size=5]The Underground Black Market[/size][/b][/center]
Got a bag full of stolen goods and nowhere to sell them? Pierre won't buy his own TV back. Head to the Black Market to fence your loot, purchase rare contraband, and keep the underground economy thriving. 

[center][b][size=5]Highly Customizable Thief Gloves[/size]
[size=4]over 15 gameplay-altering accessories[/size][/b][/center]
Your primary tool of the trade. Equip specialized gloves and slot in various accessories to build the perfect loadout for your preferred flavor of felony. Whether you're a nimble pickpocket or a methodical burglar, there's a glove build for you.
[center][/center]
[center][size=5][b]Garden Theft[/b] [/size][/center]
Why grow your own crops when your neighbors already did the hard work? Sneak into the gardens outside NPCs' homes and help yourself to whatever they've been tending. It's basically community farming — just without their consent.


[center][size=5]  [b]Pickpocketing Mechanics[/b] [/size][/center]
Why wait until a shop is closed when the shopkeeper is right there? Lift items directly from NPCs' pockets. It takes skill, nerve, and the right pair of gloves.

[center][b][size=5]Stolen Item Rarity System[/size][/b][/center]
Every stolen item comes with a special tag marking its illicit origins. Items are classified into [b]20 rarity tiers[/b] — from common household junk to priceless contraband. Collect them all, if you dare. 

[center][b][size=5]Multiplayer Support[/size][/b][/center]
Crime is better with friends. Team up for coordinated heists, cover each other's escape routes, and split the loot. Or, if you're feeling particularly treacherous, pickpocket your co-op partners and walk off with their gear. Friendships may not survive. The loot will.
[line]
[size=4][b]⚠️ Disclaimer[/b][/size] [i]All crimes are fictional. The developer does not endorse breaking and entering, theft, or operating unlicensed black markets. Pelican Town's sheriff has been notified and is, as always, doing absolutely nothing about it.[/i]

[line]
[center][i][i][size=4][b]🔧 Compatibility[/b][/size] [/i][/i][/center]

[i][b][color=red]⛔ Known Incompatibility: Zuzu City[/color][/b] Zuzu City has a serious conflict with the burglary system — all buildings in game cannot be broken into.Some places have better security, apparently. [/i]
[i][color=#00ff00][b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b] [/color]SVE is fully supported with dedicated burglary content. New locations, new targets, new loot. The expanded world means more opportunities for a life of crime.[/i]
[i][color=#ffff00][b]Other Map Mods (East Scarp, Ridgeside Village,ect)[/b] [/color]These mods are compatible in the sense that the game won't explode. However, buildings added by other mods currently have no burglary content — you can get inside, but there's nothing to steal. Consider it casing a location that just hasn't been worth your time yet. [b][color=#00ffff]Ridgeside Village[/color][/b] is planned for a future content update with full burglary support. Stay tuned. [/i]
